features: Bachata Rising, Bachata Open and Bachata Invitational are integrated directly into the existing Manual and Automatic scoring Division dropdowns instead of using a separate Special Category scoring mode
Special categories use the same scoring workflow as standard divisions and switch only the publication point logic to fixed special-category points

Bachata Rising and Bachata Open award fixed 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 points while Bachata Invitational awards fixed 3, 2, 1 points, mapped to each competitor's role-specific Novice, Intermediate or Advanced BDC progression bucket
Existing BDC ID assignment and competitor identity matching remain unchanged for special categories
Release Manager drops the obsolete worker-only database trigger that was forcing the currently running Staging version back to Available and blocking Production promotion
Release Manager recognizes the version actually running on Staging and exposes the Production path instead of offering the same version for Staging again
Environment-isolated Result Repository resolution keeps Production on Production storage and Staging on Staging storage while restoring legacy historical document links by filename
